name: Chief Ministers Green Taxi Scheme
benefit:
1. 50% of on-road vehicle cost supported (5% by the entrepreneur, 45% by the Government of Meghalaya)
1. 5% EMI co-payment support for 12 months (conditional on minimum 1500 km/month traffic compliance)
1. Credit linkage through partnered banks (MRB, MCAB, SBI, Shillong Co-operative Urban Bank)
1. Branding cost of vehicle borne by the Government (one-time)
1. Waiver of registration charges up to ₹
_eligibility_text: **For Individual:** 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Meghalaya. 1. The applicant must be between 18 and 58 years of age. 1. The applicant must hold a valid driving license. 1. The applicant must be a resident of the Greater Shillong Planning Area (GSPA). 1. The applicant must not be a credit defaulter with any bank. **For Registered Entities** 1. The entity must provide a valid Incorporation Certificate or Registration Certificate, as applicable. 1. The entity must be a recognized and registered taxicab operator, organization, Self Help Group (SHG), or cooperative based in the Greater Shillong Planning Area (GSPA). 1. The entity must have a registered office or a license to operate city taxis in the Greater Shillong Planning Area. 1. The entity must not be a credit defaulter with any bank.
